notes: Tuition: Page du programme says "178 euros + 118 euros" per year for all students, but the Moroccan Campus France page says non-EU students pay differentiated tuition of 2902 EUR per year in Licence; since the applicant is a Moroccan non-EU student with a foreign diploma, use 2902 EUR per year. Evidence quote from Campus France page is for Licence in general, not specifically this programme. Application: Foreign-diploma applicants apply via Études en France/Campus France, not Parcoursup; applicationChannel is not output for this programme as instructed. Deadline: No specific application deadline for this programme was given for non-EU applicants; the ADIUT Maroc deadline (1 Oct–15 Nov 2026) is for BUT 1st year, not this Licence. Programme page says nothing about duration: the PDF quote says "Ce parcours confère un niveau bac+3 aux étudiants des IUT" but that is for BUT, not this double licence. Language: Programme is taught in French; English is only a language vivante option, not a teaching language. Certification: Campus France page states French certification (TCF, DELF B2, DALF) is required for Études en France application, except exemptions; the page also says students applying to 100% English-taught programmes other than L1 are exempt, but this programme is not indicated as English-taught; a manual_check is noted. The B2 level is stated as "requis pour s'inscrire" on the Parcoursup page, but that page describes initial registration and is likely for all students; yet it is the only level stated for this programme, so it is treated as a requirement with manual_check. Subject prerequisites: The page lists "attendus nationaux" for Economics and Mathematics, but these are desired competencies, not formal subject requirements, so they are not encoded as rules; a manual_check may be advisable but no specific quote about required subjects is provided.

note.fr: Le dossier de candidature doit inclure un projet de formation motivé ; il est conseillé de le soigner.
note.en: The application file must include a motivated training project; it is advisable to make it carefully.

evidence.quote: Il est également recommandé de soigner le projet de formation motivé, en évitant le copier-coller et les formulations vagues ou passe-partout.
